findings.evidence: Positivity.lean:216 `theorem abs_h1_le_f1 (ρ : SpinDensity) : |h1 ρ| ≤ f1 ρ`; no `norm_transversity_le_f1` or equivalent exists in ComplexSpinDensity.lean (only `two_mul_norm_transversity_le_diag` at :199 and `soffer_bound` at :208). Roadmap §1.4 (README.md:586) asks for `|h₁| ≤ q`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem norm_transversity_le_f1 : ‖ρ.transversity‖ ≤ ρ.f1`, one line from `soffer_bound` and `abs_deltaQ_le_f1` via `linarith [le_abs_self ρ.deltaQ]`.
findings.issue: The file ports `f1_nonneg`, `abs_deltaQ_le_f1` and `soffer_bound` to `SpinDensityC` but omits the complex analogue of `PDF.abs_h1_le_f1` (Positivity.lean:216). Unlike the other two, this one is not recoverable by applying the real lemma to `re`: `PDF.abs_h1_le_f1 ρ.re` gives `|ρ.transversity.re| ≤ ρ.f1`, strictly weaker than `‖ρ.transversity‖ ≤ ρ.f1`, so a consumer following the module docstring's "the real statements applied to the real part" recipe silently gets the wrong bound.

findings.evidence: upstream/TauCeti/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/PosSemidef.lean:104 `∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → α) (x : ι → R), ...` versus PosSemidef.lean:89 `∀ {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → n) (x : ι → R), ...`.
findings.fix: Change `{ι : Type}` to `{ι : Type*}`; the proof still goes through since `posSemidef_iff_finite_sum`'s `ι` universe is a parameter that unifies with the new lemma's.
findings.issue: `PosSemidef.of_submatrix_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg` quantifies the index family as `{ι : Type}` (universe 0), while the result it wraps, `TauCeti.posSemidef_iff_finite_sum`, uses `{ι : Type*}`. The new public lemma is advertised as the "arbitrary-index generalisation" and an upstreaming candidate, yet is strictly less applicable than its source for any `n` in a higher universe.

findings.evidence: ComplexSpinDensity.lean:98 `@[simp] lemma coe_re_mat_apply_self`, :104 `lemma conj_mat_apply` (no attribute); manual uses at :272 and :290.
findings.fix: Mark `conj_mat_apply` `@[simp]`; it is terminating (`conj (ρ.mat i j) = ρ.mat j i`) and makes the transpose/conjugate normal form uniform.
findings.issue: `conj_mat_apply` is the hermiticity characteristic lemma of `SpinDensityC` and carries no `@[simp]`, while its diagonal consequence `coe_re_mat_apply_self` (:98) does. simp can therefore normalise `((ρ.mat i i).re : ℂ)` but not `conj (ρ.mat i j)`, which is the form that shows up in every parity/T-reversal argument (the file itself has to `rw [← ρ.conj_mat_apply]` at :290).

summary: The exposed surface is otherwise complete and well-annotated (def lemmas, both transfer directions, the equiv, parity/T-reversal characterisations), but the complex positivity suite drops the one real bound that does not transfer through `re`, and the new general PSD lemma is gratuitously universe-restricted relative to the TauCeti result it wraps.
